title: 第17章 授人以鱼还是授人以渔第18章 是时候来点科技震撼了
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: 赵刚的目光火热。
手掌重重拍在林默的肩膀上，
“林默同志，你做得很好。”
“非常好！”
林默听着这激动的夸奖，想起自己当时对着芬朵娜的承诺，心里多少有点没底道：
“赵大哥，我说要帮助他们，是不是有点......太冲动了？”
赵刚猛地抬起一只手，直接截断了他的话头道：
“不，你做得对！”
“这是千载难逢的机会，是我们撬开那个世界信任大门的唯机会！”
他说完，目光转向军方战略分析组的负责人，
“老李，说说你的看法。”
老李站起身，他身后的巨型屏幕瞬间切换，上面布满了各种战术标记和红色警告符号。
“报告副指挥，初步评估结果，很不乐观。”
“精灵族的单兵素质极高，每一个都是我们标准下的顶尖神射手。”
“而且看威力，堪比狙击枪。”
他话锋一转，
“他们的战术，还停留在冷兵器时代的对耗。”
“他们的弓，是传统单体弓。”
“射程、威力和射速，都已经达到了他们的天花板，再往上就是魔法了。”
“还有他们的后勤！”
老李的手指向屏幕上那片被红色方框圈出的狼藉废墟。
“箭矢弓箭生产还停留在手工作坊阶段。一场高强度战斗，就能清空他们一个月的库存。”
“若无外力介入，精灵族......撑不过下两次同等规模的围攻。”
老李的话，直接浇在指挥中心里刚刚升腾起的热火上。
新世界找到了，可新世界自己也要玩完了。
这算什么？买到一张泰坦尼克号的船票吗？
钱振华院士推开椅子，颤巍巍地走到屏幕前，伸出手似乎想触摸屏幕里芬朵娜的脸。
“一个完整的、与我们截然不同的生态系统......一个以魔法为基础的文明......”
“况且林总指挥还身处在精灵族，我们必须出手帮助他们！”
一个年轻的参谋忍不住开口：
“该怎么帮呢？”
“直接给火药技术风险太高。以他们的魔法基础，想必威力很快就会赶上我们。”
赵刚点了下头，这正是他所顾虑的。
授人以鱼，还是授人以渔？
这是个问题。
“可我们又无法直接派兵，那该怎么帮？”
整个指挥中心陷入了死寂。
一群代表着大夏最强大脑的人，被这个问题给问住了。
“复合弓！”
钱振华的声音如同一道惊雷炸响。
唰！
content_en:
Zhao Gang's eyes were fiery.
The palm of his hand slapped Lin Mo's shoulder heavily,
"Comrade Lin Mo, you did a good job."
“Very good!”
Lin Mo listened to this excited compliment and remembered the promise he made to Fenduona at that time, and felt a little unsure:
"Brother Zhao, when I said I wanted to help them, was it a bit... too impulsive?"
Zhao Gang suddenly raised a hand and directly cut off his words:
"No, you did the right thing!"
"This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, our only chance to pry open the door of trust in that world!"
After he finished speaking, he turned to the head of the military strategic analysis team.
"Lao Li, tell me what you think."
Lao Li stood up, and the giant screen behind him switched instantly. It was covered with various tactical marks and red warning symbols.
"Reporting to the deputy commander, the preliminary assessment results are very pessimistic."
"The quality of the elves' individual soldiers is extremely high, and each one of them is a top marksman according to our standards."
"And judging from the power, it's comparable to a sniper rifle."
"But..."
He changed the subject,
"Their tactics are still stuck in the cold weapon era."
"Their bows are traditional single-body bows."
"The range, power, and rate of fire have all reached their ceiling, and beyond that is magic."
"And their logistics!"
Lao Li's hand pointed to the messy ruins circled by a red box on the screen.
"The production of arrows and bows is still at the manual workshop stage. A high-intensity battle can clear out their inventory for a month."
"Without external intervention, the elves...cannot survive the next two sieges of the same scale."
Lao Li's words directly poured onto the heat that had just risen in the command center.
A new world has been found, but the new world itself is about to be finished.
What is this? Buy a ticket on the Titanic?
Academician Qian Zhenhua pushed away his chair, walked tremblingly in front of the screen, and stretched out his hand as if to touch Fenduona's face on the screen.
"A whole, completely different ecosystem from ours...a civilization based on magic..."
"Besides, Commander Lin is still among the elves, so we must help them!"
A young staff officer couldn't help but say:
"How can I help?"
"The risk of directly giving gunpowder technology is too high. Based on their magic base, their power will surely catch up with ours soon."
Zhao Gang nodded, this was exactly what he was worried about.
Give a man a fish, or teach him to fish?
This is a problem.
"But we can't send troops directly, so how can we help?"
The entire command center fell into dead silence.
A group of people representing Daxia's most powerful brains were stunned by this question.
"Compound bow!"
Qian Zhenhua's voice was like a thunderous explosion.
Uh-huh!
